messages.subject: Brightwater v Caldervale — claim issued
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia, Liam,

The claim has been issued in the Commercial Court — Claim No. CL-2026-000148 — and the Particulars served on Birchall Stone today. The claim is for the £90,000 debt and £840,000 damages (before the avoided-cost credit), plus interest and costs. Defendant has 28 days to file a Defence. I'll update you when it lands.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 1100
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
